title: Naturally Crispy Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring crispy empanadas filled with fatty beef and scallions, served in a scallop shell vessel, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped scallions, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the beaten eggs to the bowl and mix until the eggs are fully incorporated.
Divide the double rise bread into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a quarter of the beef mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and place them in a scallop shell vessel.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
